bounds.exhaustive cases: AmberT 2 < RedT 4 < WakeGrace 5 ticks, SleepGap 3, UnknownAmber 3, Recovery 2, Cap 8 (ordering-preserving, not production)
bounds.replay traces: production thresholds at 300 s ticks: amber 2, red 6, sleep gap 3, wake grace 24, alert red after 6 ticks
bounds.agent writes: one append per awake tick at most; a tick's poll ingests everything readable (30 s polls inside a 300 s tick)
bounds.alert timing: one watcher poll per model tick; production polls every 30 s, so a 300 s episode can surface one tick later than the model's when it starts within 30 s of a read

atomicity: One TLA step is one health tick. Within it the watcher polls (or not), then the monitor reads and evaluates; on the first tick after a wake the order is free (o).
